description:
On this episode of The Performance Layer, WTA Chair Valerie Camillo and ATP Chief Tour Officer Andre Silva sit down with Forbes to discuss how the women’s and men’s professional tennis tours are positioning themselves to capitalize on a surge in global popularity. Camillo discusses equal prize money initiatives, emerging international talent, and new corporate sponsorship opportunities. Silva addresses expanding the ATP’s global calendar footprint, enhancing baseline earning programs for lower-ranked players, and navigating player representation within the sport's governance structure.
